title: Container Bookings: late document fees and grace hours by tier
content:
## Scope
This reference covers the Container Bookings product line and gives, per tier, the grace hours after the shipping-instruction (SI) and verified gross mass (VGM) cut-offs, the late fees for each document, and the free late-document allowance.

## What each setting means
- **SI grace**: the hours after the SI cut-off within which late shipping instructions are still accepted for the allocated vessel.
- **Late SI fee**: the fee for shipping instructions received after the SI cut-off but within grace, in USD per booking.
- **VGM grace**: the hours after the VGM cut-off within which a late verified gross mass is still accepted for the allocated vessel.
- **Late VGM fee**: the fee for a verified gross mass received after the VGM cut-off but within grace, in USD per container.
- **Free late-document allowance**: the number of late documentation submissions recorded at 0.00 before fees apply.

## Tier table
| Tier | SI grace (hours) | Late SI fee (USD per booking) | VGM grace (hours) | Late VGM fee (USD per container) | Free late-document allowance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 12 | 150.00 | 6 | 120.00 | 0 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 12 | 125.00 | 6 | 100.00 | 0 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 24 | 100.00 | 12 | 90.00 | 1 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 24 | 85.00 | 12 | 75.00 | 2 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 24 | 100.00 | 12 | 90.00 | 1 |
| AHL Premium Express | 36 | 65.00 | 12 | 60.00 | 3 |

## Points of judgement
**Which tiers have no free late-document allowance at all?** AHL Spot Saver and AHL Spot Flex, whose allowance is 0.

**Is the late SI fee charged per container?** No. The late SI fee is stated per booking; the late VGM fee is the one stated per container.

**Which tier gives the longest SI grace?** AHL Premium Express, with 36 hours; VGM grace never exceeds 12 hours on any tier.
